title: About {{site}}
metaDescription: Free open-source online toolbox: crypto, converters, encoders, web, text and image utilities. Everything runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
intro: {{site}} is a free, open-source toolbox with {{count}} everyday tools: crypto, format converters, encoders, web utilities, text and image tools. Everything runs locally in your browser — no data is collected or uploaded. Three features reach out: IP lookup queries third-party public services; the AI in Resume Studio and AI Image Gen Canvas is opt-in and talks directly to the provider you configure; and the online music library in Text PV is off by default, sending the playlist you type to the Meting instance you configure.
whyBody: AI can certainly do these jobs — hash a string, convert a format, decode a JWT. But that means maintaining a skill or a workflow, re-describing the task every time, waiting for it to think, and correcting the occasional improvisation. The inputs and outputs were already deterministic, so there is no reason to rebuild the wheel on every run while burning tokens. So these became fixed pages: open it, get the same result, no quota spent, no improvisation.
privacyBody: All computations happen in your browser. Nothing you type is ever uploaded to a server. Two exceptions: IP lookup sends queries to third-party public services (named on the page itself), and the opt-in AI in Resume Studio and AI Image Gen Canvas sends requests directly from your browser to the provider you configure, never through this site.
fastBody: Static site, lazily loaded modules, no backend, no tracking, no ads.
openSourceBody: Tool design and features are inspired by the open-source project
licenseNote: This project is open-sourced under the MIT license — free to use, modify and distribute
